description: This file defines custom loss functions (focal loss and smooth L1 loss) for object detection models, specifically for use with TensorFlow and Keras. It includes functions to create these loss functions with configurable parameters, and references external TensorFlow and Keras modules.

methods.name: focal
methods.description: Creates a focal loss function with specified alpha, gamma, and cutoff parameters for use in object detection models.

methods.name: smooth_l1
methods.description: Creates a smooth L1 loss function with a specified sigma parameter for use in bounding box regression.
